---
title: "Rye Biomass"
format: html
---
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(kableExtra)
```
```{r}
rye_biomass <- read_xlsx("data/clean_biomass.xlsx") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(dry_mass = dry_mass_dry_bag_mass - dry_bag_mass)
kable(rye_biomass)
```

```{r}
rye_biomass %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = dry_mass, color = as.factor(plot_id))) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Rye Biomass Over Time",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Dry Mass (g)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Boxplot grouped by date and plot_id
```{r}
rye_biomass %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(date), y = dry_mass, fill = as.factor(plot_id))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Rye Biomass",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Dry Mass (g / m^2)",
       fill = "Plot") +
  theme_minimal() 
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

p1 <- rye_biomass %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(plot_id), y = dry_mass, fill = as.factor(plot_id))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +                
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15), alpha = 0.6, size = 1) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Plot") +           
  labs(title = "Rye Biomass",
       y = expression("Dry Mass (g/"~m^2*")")) +  
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap( ~ date)
p1$data %>% 
  select(date, plot_id, area, dry_mass) %>% 
  kable()
#ggsave("figures/rye_biomass_plot.tiff", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Nitrogen leaching
```{r}
cumulative_flow_data <- read_csv("data/clean/2023_2024_SABR_tile_cumulative_n.csv")
gs_23 <- cumulative_flow_data %>% 
  dplyr::filter(growing_season == 2023, `year(date)` != 2024)

gs_24 <- cumulative_flow_data %>% 
  dplyr::filter(growing_season == 2024, !(`year(date)` %in% c(2023,2025)))

# For drainage summary:
drainage_summary_23 <- gs_23 %>%
  group_by(treatment, plot) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = cumulative_n_loss_mg, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(growing_season = 2023)

drainage_summary_24 <- gs_24 %>%
  group_by(treatment, plot) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = cumulative_n_loss_mg, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(growing_season = 2024)

drainage_summary <- bind_rows(drainage_summary_23, drainage_summary_24) %>%
  mutate(
    cumulative_n_loss_kg_ha = (cumulative_n_loss_mg / 1e6) / 0.145,
    N_Type = "Nitrogen Leaching",
    Treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Corn", "Soy", "Sorghum", "Sorghum + Rye"))
  )
```

```{r}
nitrate_data <- drainage_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(treatment %in% c("Sorghum + Rye"),
         !is.na(approx_nitrate_mg_l)) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) 
```


```{r}
colnames(nitrate_data)
nitrate_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(plot), y = cumulative_n_loss_kg_ha, color = as.factor(plot))) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +                
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Plot") +           
  labs(title = "Cumulative N Leached",
       y = expression("Nitrogen (kg/ha)")) +  
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap( ~ year)
        ggsave("figures/sorg_rye_cumulative_leaching_plot.tiff", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

p2 <- nitrate_data %>%

```{r}
# Summarize mean rye biomass per plot and year
biomass_summary <- rye_biomass %>%
  mutate(year = format(as.Date(date), "%Y")) %>%
  group_by(plot_id, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(dry_mass), .groups = 'drop')

# Summarize cumulative nitrate leaching per plot and year (already filtered for Sorghum + Rye)
leaching_summary <- nitrate_data %>%
  mutate(year = format(as.Date(date), "%Y")) %>% 
  rename(plot_id = plot) %>%
  group_by(plot_id, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_cumulative_n_loss = mean(cumulative_n_loss_kg_ha), .groups = 'drop')

# Join the two summaries by plot and year
combined_data <- biomass_summary %>%
  inner_join(leaching_summary, by = c("plot_id", "year"))

# Scatter plot with regression line
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = mean_biomass, y = mean_cumulative_n_loss, color = year)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Year") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Rye Biomass vs Cumulative Nitrate Leaching",
    x = expression("Mean Rye Biomass (g/"~m^2*")"),
    y = expression("Mean Cumulative Nitrate Leaching (kg N/ha)")
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
ggsave("figures/biomassvsleachingyear.png")
```


```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

# Step 1: Get rye harvest dates per plot and year
harvest_dates <- rye_biomass %>%
  mutate(year = year(as.Date(date))) %>%
  group_by(plot_id, year) %>%
  summarise(harvest_date = max(as.Date(date)), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: Prepare raw cumulative flow data and add year column
cumulative_flow_data <- cumulative_flow_data %>%
  mutate(year = year(as.Date(date)),
         plot_id = plot)  # rename plot for join

# Step 3: Join harvest dates and filter cumulative flow data to dates ≤ harvest date
cumulative_flow_filtered <- cumulative_flow_data %>%
  inner_join(harvest_dates, by = c("plot_id", "year")) %>%
  filter(as.Date(date) <= harvest_date)

# Step 4: Now slice max cumulative N loss per plot, treatment, year on filtered data
drainage_summary_filtered <- cumulative_flow_filtered %>%
  group_by(treatment, plot_id, year) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = cumulative_n_loss_mg, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    cumulative_n_loss_kg_ha = (cumulative_n_loss_mg / 1e6) / 0.145,
    N_Type = "Nitrogen Leaching",
    Treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Corn", "Soy", "Sorghum", "Sorghum + Rye"))
  )

# Step 5: Filter for sorghum + rye treatment and prepare for plotting
nitrate_data_filtered <- drainage_summary_filtered %>%
  filter(Treatment == "Sorghum + Rye") %>%
  mutate(year = as.character(year))

# Step 6: Summarize biomass as before
biomass_summary <- rye_biomass %>%
  mutate(year = as.character(year(date))) %>%
  group_by(plot_id, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(dry_mass), .groups = "drop")

# Step 7: Join biomass and filtered nitrate leaching data
combined_filtered <- biomass_summary %>%
  inner_join(nitrate_data_filtered, by = c("plot_id", "year"))

# Step 8: Plot
ggplot(combined_filtered, aes(x = mean_biomass, y = cumulative_n_loss_kg_ha, color = year)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Year") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Rye Biomass vs Cumulative Nitrate Leaching (Filtered to Harvest Date)",
    x = expression("Mean Rye Biomass (g/"~m^2*")"),
    y = expression("Mean Cumulative Nitrate Leaching (kg N/ha)")
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
ggsave("figures/biomassvsleachingtoharvestdate.png")

```
